Lemma
[A Metric-Preserving Map Pushes Orthonormal Frames Forward]

↗ def:metric-preserving

If $\varphi :(M,g)\to (\widetilde M,\widetilde g)$ preserves the metric and $(E_i)$ is $g$-orthonormal, then $(d\varphi _x(E_i|_x))$ is $\widetilde g$-orthonormal.

Proof

↗ def:metric-preserving \sketch Metric preservation gives $\langle d\varphi _xE_i,d\varphi _xE_j\rangle _{\widetilde g}=\langle E_i,E_j\rangle _g=\delta _{ij}$.

□
